{{Top}}
[[File:MinstrelClassSpaceYacht-LoNH.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstrel''-class space yacht]]]]
'''Yacht''' was the term given to any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or aquatic vehicle used primarily for recreational purposes. Most yachts were similar in size to [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], though a few were as large as small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. They tended to be fairly expensive vessels, with highly luxurious accommodations. As they tended to be relatively fast ships, some yachts were employed by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], though they usually had less cargo capacity than dedicated [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].
